plan.purpose: Reconcile the selected, previously read climate-method references for pending agroforestry/FMNR overrides into source intake. This is not an empirical T4 threshold extraction.
plan.screened_by: Codex; source screening under v1.8.1; method-source admission only
plan.limits: Exact selected-reference follow-up from 2026-11-25 climate audit; no search engine universe or saturation claimed.
plan.stop_reason: Reached the end of the explicit admission subset.
plan.omissions: No new general discovery sweep, OpenAlex/Lens/AGRIS search or language expansion. Prior broad-search totals not reconstructed. No extracted findings or scientific approvals.
plan.inclusion_criteria: Identifiable publication directly supplies product definition, treeline mechanism/model limitation or FMNR climatic implementation guidance. Retain methodological sources with explicit transfer holds; registration does not pass claim-level T4 gate.
